observations: Photo 0 shows a Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The lens is labeled 'CANON ZOOM LENS EF-S 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6 STM'. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS Rebel T6i' visible on the top right.
Photo 1 shows the top of the camera, including the mode dial, shutter button, and hot shoe. The lens is attached, and the camera strap is visible.
Photo 2 shows the back of the camera, with the LCD screen, viewfinder, and control buttons. The camera appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust on the body.
All photos show a watermark 'MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.claim: Very Neat and Clean USA Used Canon EOS T6i/750D DSLR Camera still looking like a new one
claims.evidence: Photos show the camera and lens in used condition with minor scuffs and dust. The 'USA Used' claim cannot be verified remotely. The 'still looking like a new one' is subjective and not proven by photos.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the camera turning on, menu navigation, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass and internal elements, or a video showing the lens being used.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens may be damaged

risks.risk: Camera may have sensor damage or high shutter count
risks.proof: Photo of the camera's menu showing shutter count, or a video of the camera taking a photo and displaying the image on screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor may be damaged

risks.risk: Camera may have missing or non-functional accessories (battery, charger, strap)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out, or a video of the camera being powered on with battery and charger.
risks.if_unproven: priced as accessories may be missing

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the camera turning on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass and internal elements.
Photo of the camera's menu showing shutter count.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, strap, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
